affected_predicate.description: A private birthday message with a birthday cake image is sent to Alex in Mattermost.

competing_trace_defects.description: After the password is entered and Log In is clicked, the login form visibly reports that the email and password combination is incorrect.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 6, the claimed completed login is contradicted by the visible login form with only user123 entered and no password; the action clicks Log In while it remains disabled. The later steps visibly focus and fill the password field, interrupting that missing-password mechanism, but the subsequent login attempt displays an incorrect-credentials error and the trace ends before any private message or image upload is shown.

summary: The reused false login-success claim led to a disabled login click before the password was entered; that missing-password condition was later corrected, while a separately observable incorrect-credentials error remained.
